summary.text:
Need E language code, no if/else/return/curly braces/half-width assignment. Use .如果真 / .否则 or use branch. "不得保留...半角赋值符号" means use = or no assignments. Write:

.子程序 取较大值, 整数型, 公开
.参数 a, 整数型
.参数 b, 整数型
.如果 (a > b)
    返回 (a)
.否则
    返回 (b)

Wait "不得保留 if, else, return" — those are English keywords; E language uses .如果/.否则/返回 which are Chinese, allowed. Also "返回 (0)" in startup — return 0. Keep that but it uses Chinese 返回, fine.

Also cannot use half-width assignment "=" as assignment — we don't assign anything.
